r.activity_record_id, r.team_id, t.name AS team_name, r.activity_dttm, r.title, r.participant_count, r.status_code, creator.name AS created_by_name, ( SELECT f.stored_file_id FROM activity_record_file f WHERE f.activity_record_id = r.activity_record_id AND f.file_role_code = 'EVIDENCE' AND f.replaced_dttm IS NULL ORDER BY f.display_order, f.activity_record_file_id LIMIT 1 ) AS representative_stored_file_id, r.updated_dttm
mapper.select: SELECT FROM activity_record WHERE activity_record_id = #{activityRecordId} AND
SELECT FROM activity_record WHERE activity_record_id = #{activityRecordId} AND FOR UPDATE

SELECT activity_record_file_id, activity_record_id, stored_file_id, file_role_code, display_order, uploaded_by_member_id, replaced_by_activity_record_file_id, replaced_dttm, replaced_by_member_id, created_dttm, updated_dttm FROM activity_record_file WHERE activity_record_file_id = #{activityRecordFileId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.activity_record_id, r.team_id, t.name AS team_name, r.activity_dttm, r.title, r.body, r.participant_count, creator.name AS created_by_name, r.updated_dttm FROM activity_record r JOIN team t ON t.team_id = r.team_id JOIN member creator ON creator.member_id = r.created_by_member_id WHERE r.activity_record_id = #{activityRecordId} AND r.status_code = 'APPROVED' AND r.deleted_dttm IS NULL

SELECT r.activity_record_id, r.team_id, t.name AS team_name, r.activity_dttm, r.title, r.body, r.participant_count, r.status_code, r.created_by_member_id, creator.name AS created_by_name, updater.name AS updated_by_name, r.submitted_dttm, r.reviewed_dttm, r.updated_dttm, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM activity_report_document report WHERE report.activity_record_id = r.activity_record_id ) AS is_report_document FROM activity_record r JOIN team t ON t.team_id = r.team_id JOIN member creator ON creator.member_id = r.created_by_member_id JOIN member updater ON updater.member_id = r.updated_by_member_id WHERE r.activity_record_id = #{activityRecordId} AND r.deleted_dttm IS NULL

SELECT f.activity_record_file_id, f.stored_file_id, f.file_role_code, f.display_order, f.uploaded_by_member_id, uploader.name AS uploaded_by_name, f.created_dttm AS uploaded_dttm FROM activity_record_file f JOIN member uploader ON uploader.member_id = f.uploaded_by_member_id WHERE f.activity_record_id = #{activityRecordId} AND f.replaced_dttm IS NULL ORDER BY f.file_role_code DESC, f.display_order, f.activity_record_file_id

SELECT revision.revision_no, revision.activity_dttm, revision.title, revision.body, revision.participant_count, member.name AS changed_by_name, revision.changed_dttm, revision.change_reason FROM activity_record_revision revision JOIN member ON member.member_id = revision.changed_by_member_id WHERE revision.activity_record_id = #{activityRecordId} ORDER BY revision.revision_no DESC

SELECT history.previous_status_code AS previous_status, history.new_status_code AS new_status, history.comment, member.name AS reviewed_by_name, history.reviewed_dttm FROM activity_review_history history JOIN member ON member.member_id = history.reviewed_by_member_id WHERE history.activity_record_id = #{activityRecordId} ORDER BY history.reviewed_dttm DESC, history.activity_review_history_id DESC

SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM activity_record record JOIN activity_record_file file ON file.activity_record_id = record.activity_record_id WHERE record.activity_record_id = #{activityRecordId} AND record.status_code = 'APPROVED' AND record.deleted_dttm IS NULL AND file.stored_file_id = #{storedFileId} AND file.replaced_dttm IS NULL )
SELECT revision_no FROM activity_record_revision WHERE activity_record_id = #{activityRecordId} ORDER BY revision_no DESC LIMIT 1
